goal: Build research-backed standalone skills with no sibling repo dependencies

skills.name: research-synthesis
skills.description: Review and synthesize academic or technical claims with provenance, limitations, and reproducible source tables.

skills.name: evidence-audit
skills.description: Audit a claim against evidence, extract supported provisions, confidence and gaps.

skills.name: literature-matrix
skills.description: Build and maintain a structured local research matrix with identifiers and provenance.

skills.name: repository-indexing
skills.description: Index a supplied local repository's files and architecture without external repository calls.

skills.name: task-planning
skills.description: Translate requirements into phased implementation with prerequisites and acceptance gates.

skills.name: test-design
skills.description: Create executable deterministic tests and failure-focused cases for a software component.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review local code diffs for defects, maintainability and regression risk.

skills.name: debugging-triage
skills.description: Diagnose reported failures with reproducible local traces and minimal change proposals.

skills.name: release-readiness
skills.description: Audit artifact readiness, rollback, provenance, licensing and release evidence.

skills.name: security-threat-model
skills.description: Create a threat model for a bounded product, repository, or workflow.

skills.name: prompt-injection-audit
skills.description: Test untrusted instructions, tools, and retrieved-content boundaries.

skills.name: data-quality-audit
skills.description: Inspect tabular or structured input for missingness, leakage, schema drift and validity.

skills.name: agent-evaluation
skills.description: Specify and run offline trigger, task-success and misuse evaluations with evidence.

skills.name: feedback-curation
skills.description: Curate permissioned human/AI preference examples with immutable splits and rubrics.

skills.name: model-benchmarking
skills.description: Compare recorded model outputs on quality, calibration, latency and cost.

skills.name: model-routing
skills.description: Design and evaluate an offline bounded router with strong-model fallback.

skills.name: prompt-optimization
skills.description: Compare prompt variants with strict holdouts and grounded metrics.

skills.name: critique-and-revision
skills.description: Run bounded generate-critique-revise with objective stopping criteria.

skills.name: episodic-feedback
skills.description: Record, bound and evaluate task-scoped reflections without neural training.

skills.name: experiment-analysis
skills.description: Design and analyze reproducible controlled evaluations with uncertainty.

skills.name: documentation-authoring
skills.description: Produce structured, source-traceable technical documentation with link checks.

skills.name: handoff-checkpoint
skills.description: Write resumable engineering checkpoints with blockers, evidence and next gates.

skills.name: incident-triage
skills.description: Structure incident severity, evidence timeline and safe recovery planning.

skills.name: dependency-audit
skills.description: Audit local module dependency boundaries and construct offline supply-chain reports.
